integrity: Theorem reconstructed from the Fourier characteristic-function identity and analytic radial integration; numerical checker independently corroborates selected cases and does not certify all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite integer dimension, isotropic scalar Brownian diffusivity and synchronous scalar contraction; no result for anisotropic/reset-time-dependent protocols.
The established three-dimensional Bessel contact asymptotic is prior work, not a separately novel special case.
Independent scientific validation and exhaustive publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Exact planar contact law and a dimension ladder for proportional Brownian resetting
